info.name: EmergencyConnectUAE™ – Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Complete Postman test collection for CSC408 Programming Assignment 3.

Covers all TC-01 through TC-65:
  • Auth (register, login, logout, validation)
  • MFA (TOTP setup, verify, disable)
  • Incidents (CRUD, status transitions, pagination)
  • Emergency Units (create, query)
  • Unit Assignment with Redis Distributed Lock
  • Redis Cache Validation (hit/miss/eviction)
  • Redis Session Storage (session lifecycle)
  • Security (rate limit, CORS, blacklist, headers, traversal, injection, JWT tampering)
  • Hospitals & Audit Logs

SETUP:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set collection variable: baseUrl = https://localhost:8443 (or your server URL)
3. Run TC-01 (Register) then TC-04 (Login) first – jwt_token will be auto-saved
4. Run folders in order for correct variable dependencies

For concurrency tests (TC-39, TC-51): use the Collection Runner with multiple iterations.

item.name: TC-39 🔁 Concurrency Test – Parallel Assignment Race (Run with Collection Runner)

request.description:
CONCURRENCY TEST: Run this request 10 times simultaneously using the Collection Runner (iterations=10, delay=0ms). Only ONE should succeed (201). All others should return 400/409/500. This demonstrates Redis distributed lock correctness under concurrent load.

Collection Runner settings:
  - Iterations: 10
  - Delay: 0 ms
  - Check 'Run collection without stopping'

Expected result: 1 success (201), 9 failures (4xx/5xx)

exec: // In a parallel run, track how many 201s appear
pm.test('Concurrent assignment success (should be exactly 1)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
console.log('❌ Assignment REJECTED (status ' + status + ') – lock protected correctness');
